usageNotes: Use this endpoint to audit or monitor task history on a specific PDM node — useful after triggering async operations to confirm completion or identify failures. Unprivileged users only see their own tasks; to see all users' tasks the caller must hold Sys.Audit on /system/tasks. The default page size is 50; use 'limit' and 'start' together for pagination, or set limit=0 to retrieve all matching tasks at once.

examples.summary: List only failed tasks from the last 24 hours on node 'pdm01'

tips: Use 'running': true to poll for in-progress tasks immediately after triggering an async operation.
'typefilter' does a substring match on worker_type (e.g. 'backup', 'vzdump', 'syncjob') — no exact-match required.
Each returned item includes a UPID string that can be passed to the task log/status endpoints to retrieve full output.
Combine 'since' and 'until' UNIX epoch values to scope results to a specific maintenance window.
Pass 'userfilter' as 'user@realm' (e.g. 'root@pam') to narrow results to a single authenticator identity.
